text: Our designated approver left on Monday. The request is stranded in her queue and nobody can sign it off. This is wrecking the launch.
Can an admin reassign a pending approval? We are copying the request to a new workflow by hand for now.
Love the board. Could we pick a backup reviewer when setting up approval? This can wait.
I am fed up with chasing a reviewer who is on leave. A second approval can be filed manually, but it eats up the afternoon.
The sign-off step has no one assigned after the reviewer account was closed. We cannot release the order until this clears.
Would it be possible to delegate approval to a different teammate before a reviewer goes on leave? Just an idea for next quarter.
It is annoying to get a push alert and a matching email for every reply. We can ignore the extra messages for now.
Could you add a digest? We currently spend Friday afternoon clearing identical comment alerts.
The app has been great for our crew. One optional improvement would be fewer notification emails.
I turned off the comment alerts and still receive them. This is frustrating. We are manually setting email rules each week.
Is there a way to combine inbox alerts into one daily note? A nice-to-have for the next planning cycle.
We hate that mandatory job alerts drown in duplicate notifications. We cannot run the overnight job safely and have no workaround.
A 40,000-row CSV download dies at 99 percent. We cannot provide the compliance file today. This is incredibly frustrating.
The downloaded report misses a custom column. We can copy the value manually from the board.
Really happy with the reporting screens. It would be nice if the exported spreadsheet kept the date formatting.
It is painful to repair the exported CSV every week. The download includes rows we filtered out. We can clean them manually.
The CSV export produces a blank file. Finance cannot submit the report and has no other way to generate it.
Can downloaded reports remember the selected sort order? Optional for our use case.
An external guest can open a private board. We are unhappy about this and cannot reopen the workspace until access is contained.
The guest invite rejects our contractor. An employee currently sends each attachment by hand.
We like the collaboration features. A folder-level guest role would be useful someday.
Our guest sees a permission denied screen for the shared card. Pretty fed up with uploading the same file separately.
The outside reviewer cannot open anything through the guest link. Approval of the order cannot proceed and there is no workaround.
Could we preview which shared folders an external invite will let the guest open? No rush.
It is annoying that exact task names vanish from search. We can hunt through the projects manually.
Can workspace search include filenames? We have no urgent need.
We are happy with the board. It would be helpful if archived tasks ranked below current work in search.
Nothing comes back for the known incident number. This is awful. The response team cannot proceed without the task and has no alternative.
The search results still show yesterday's names. We verify the names in each project separately for now.
Could we keep the selected filters when returning to search results? Just a suggestion.
The calendar connector is no longer picking up due dates. I am frustrated. We cannot dispatch the on-call schedule today.
Two copies of each task arrive from the webhook. We remove the duplicates manually every morning.
The integration has generally been excellent. An advance warning for token expiry would be nice.
I am tired of typing task status twice when Slack sync falls behind. We can keep updating both sides manually.
The external API connector stopped after a credentials change. No alternative works for tonight's handoff.
It would be nice to see when the calendar last synced. We can keep working as normal.
The compact layout is great. Thank you for adding it.
Can you add our tax ID to the receipt? No deadline pressure.
I am disappointed that the interface ignores larger font settings. I can zoom each page, but it takes time.
We would like a keyboard shortcut for moving cards. A small request.
This is awful. Our boards load entirely blank and nobody can do today's work. We have no workaround.
The new dark appearance looks great and we can keep working as usual.
